what: Three bounded contexts proposed for recap-api: library (books, positions, server, settings), preparation (transcription and who's-who index by content hash), catch-up (offer, recap, ask, who's who, reports). Least sure: library <-> catch-up — FR-013's two taps from play read as one actor's job (merge), while the change test (FR-005/006 gradient and tiers vs FR-028/029/032 position, sync and player) and US1's engine-only phase 1 say two. Confirm or overturn D1 in specs/001-audiobook-recap/decisions.md.

Recaps, answers, ratings and reports are per book and never served across accounts; only the transcription and index are shared by hash (keeps Principle IX exact). Confirm or overturn D8 in specs/001-audiobook-recap/decisions.md.
v1 prepares English only; a book whose first transcribed chapter is in another language fails preparation with that reason. Scope the PRD did not state. Confirm or overturn D15.

Split order: walking skeleton first (LB3 import heads the library, CU4-CU6 request/generate/hear head catch-up after CU1), companion mode after position tracking. Confirm or overturn D19; reasons per row in story-split.md.
In what order do several imported files' chapters run? Tags, then names in natural order, never the selection order; the hash follows the same order (docs/adr/0002).

What is a book called when its files carry no title tag or disagree, and a chapter when its mark has no title? First tagged file's title, else the first file's name; author and chapter title optional, never a sentinel (docs/adr/0003).
The same listener imports the same audio again under a new bookId: a second book, no refusal, no cross-stream guard.

A position entered by hand (LB8) counts as the last-listened time the gap is measured from: the gap runs from the latest instant the listening stream holds - a stop, the server last-listened time, an entry, or an earlier resume. Recorded in specs/001-audiobook-recap/decisions.md D27.

Entry D35 in specs/001-audiobook-recap/decisions.md; R1-R3, R5 in slices/LB8/examples.md.

Moving the position backwards by hand carries no warning about the recap cache beyond the preview and Confirm; the cache is catch-up's rule (A5, FR-008) read off PositionEntered. Entry D37; R3 and R8 in slices/LB8/examples.md.
